text: The correct graph showing the variation of the resistance (R) of a cylindrical metal wire as a function of its radius (r), keeping its length and temperature constant, is :

options.label: A
options.text: A straight line of positive slope, starting at the origin and rising.

options.label: B
options.text: A straight line of negative slope, falling from a high value on the R-axis to meet the r-axis.

options.label: C
options.text: A curve falling steeply from a high value and then flattening towards the r-axis without meeting it.

options.label: D
options.text: A curve starting from a high value on the R-axis, running almost flat at first and then bending down steeply to meet the r-axis.
